login.title: Sign in to the workspace
login.subtitle: Handle tasks in multiple tabs within one window after signing in.
login.failed: Sign-in failed, please try again later

home.lead: This page runs in the “Home” tab of vue-stack-tabs. Cards below open new tabs, and each tab keeps its own component instance, cache, and in-tab navigation stack.
home.aboutDesc: Learn about tabs, caching, and in-tab forward/back navigation.
home.settingsDesc: View the current account and layout information.
home.iframeDesc: Open a static page in an iframe tab.

about.title: About tab
about.lead: This page is an independent tab. Closing and reopening it recreates the page; switching to another tab keeps this page instance cached, so the input and scroll position are preserved when you return.
about.inputLabel: Type something, switch to “Home”, then come back:
about.stackLead: A tab can also maintain its own page stack: the button below moves forward to “Detail” inside the current tab. Going back from Detail only returns within this tab and does not affect other tabs.
about.openSettings: Open settings in a new tab

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: This shows the current sign-in state. Signing out clears the tabs and returns to the sign-in page.

tableDemo.title: VXE Table demo
tableDemo.lead: VXE Table is fully imported; the table-related components below can be used directly.

elementPlusDemo.title: Element Plus demo
elementPlusDemo.lead: Common Element Plus components are shown below. Switch the style source to compare the project theme with the Element Plus default look; built-in text follows the language too.
elementPlusDemo.dialogContent: This is an Element Plus dialog.
elementPlusDemo.alertDescription: This content comes from the Element Plus Alert component.

permissionDemo.title: Permission guard demo
permissionDemo.lead: This content is visible only when the current account has the {permission} permission. Sign in as {admin} to see it; signing in as {viewer} renders a 403 inside the current tab.
permissionDemo.alertDescription: This content is wrapped by PermissionGuard. Without permission, a 403 is rendered inside the current tab without changing the URL or tab title.

layerDemo.title: Layer demo
layerDemo.lead: Open layers programmatically with vue-lite-layer. Colors, radii and font sizes follow Element Plus and the selected theme; button labels follow the interface language.
layerDemo.tip: Element Plus components inside a layer inherit the current ElConfigProvider locale. Reopen the layer after switching theme or color scheme to see the latest appearance.

basic.title: Basic layer
basic.content: A layer opened with plain text content. Drag the title bar to move it, or minimize and maximize it.

confirm.title: Confirm action
confirm.content: Confirming closes the layer and shows a message; the footer buttons are rendered with Element Plus inside the content component.

detail.title: Detail page
detail.lead: This page entered the current tab's page stack via {code}. Going back returns to the “About” tab page, and the input there is preserved.

error.unauthorizedSubtitle: This page requires sign-in. Please sign in first.
error.forbiddenSubtitle: The current account cannot access this page. Contact an administrator or switch accounts.
error.notFoundSubtitle: The page you visited does not exist or has been removed. Check the address.
error.serverSubtitle: The page failed to load. Please try again later.
